high_level_description: A single full-body woman in a pink floral sundress and yellow straw hat, bending slightly, centered on a 1600x900 canvas with pale blue sky above and green grass below.

style_description.photo: wide aspect ratio still, front-facing, centered framing

compositional_deconstruction.background: pale blue sky occupying upper 780px; grassy green ground occupying lower 120px

right arm: thin pink rectangle, angled down-right, 50px wide × 140px tall
left leg: vertical pink rectangle, 30px wide × 180px tall
right leg: vertical pink rectangle, 30px wide × 180px tall
left foot: small horizontal pink rectangle, 40px wide × 20px tall
right foot: small horizontal pink rectangle, 40px wide × 20px tall
